shared_controls: One registered standalone Luna and Sol assignment per task while common prompts/tools/budgets match; no best-of selection across repeats.
first_execution_unit: Independent environment/adapter controls, then one complete development task block, then measured cost/runtime review before continuation.
selection: Required review is a mechanism/quality control, not evidence of autonomous routing. Freeze the optional policy after development. Do not expand sealed validation if development has no credible rescue benefit; register any further development separately rather than tune on validation.
model_identity_caveat: Requested proprietary aliases are not immutable weight revisions.
reason: Measure rescue of Luna failures, distinguish voluntary routing from required handoff/integration capability
snapshot: Capture exact candidate patch before the first expert response using a separate Git index. Regrade after generation with unchanged official PatchReplayAgent and patch_name=pre-handoff.patch. Never expose that grade during solving.
primary_routing_diagnostics: Actual pre-handoff failures repaired after consultation
Correct pre-handoff candidates regressed after consultation
Failure to perform a required review
All controller/expert/integration native tokens and total cost
noncompliance: Keep and grade every required-review assignment even if no consultation occurs; report noncompliance separately.
live_mechanism_probe: results/handoff-mechanism-001; required context-only handoff, not benchmark accuracy or autonomous routing
